purpose: Preliminary interactive reference evidence; not the planned conformance manifest or an implementation-acceptance result.
method: Reduced CP1252 sources were entered into the VisuAlg editor and read back for equality before execution. Raw reference panel text was read through WM_GETTEXT and encoded as UTF-8. Desktop captures and operational details are retained privately.
limitations: Eight selected probes, not the complete blocking inventory or the 73 bundled examples.
No generated-file or stdin-input behavior was tested in these eight probes.
Reference panel text is a Unicode control observation encoded as UTF-8, not original console output bytes.
The reference panel includes application start/end notices and CRLF; its text is retained unchanged.
The first power-associativity capture retained a preceding error dialog and was discarded. This entry uses the fresh rerun with unique source/output markers.
Reference error messages in windowless labels are evidenced by screenshots; summaries do not invent diagnostic columns.
Published candidate diagnostic paths are reduced to filenames. Candidate stderr hashes describe the published redacted text. Desktop captures are not published.

probes.source:
algoritmo "output-format"
inicio
escreval("BEGIN")
escreval("I=[", 1, "]")
escreval("R=[", 1.5, "]")
escreval("Z=[", 2.0, "]")
escreval("W=[", 1:3, "]")
escreval("P=[", 1.5:5:2, "]")
escreval("END")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN
I=[ 1]
R=[ 1.5]
Z=[ 2]
W=[  1]
P=[ 1.50]
END

Fim da execução.
probes.comparison: VisuAlg inserts a leading space for unformatted positive numbers and uses a decimal point on this en-US guest; PortuGo omits that space and uses a comma.

probes.source:
algoritmo "exp-two"
inicio
escreval("BEGIN")
escreval(exp(2, 3))
escreval("END")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN
 8
END

Fim da execução.
probes.comparison: VisuAlg accepts exp(2, 3) and prints 8; PortuGo emits E004 for the second argument and exits 0.

probes.source:
algoritmo "exact-division-integer"
var
x: inteiro
inicio
escreval("BEGIN")
x <- 4/2
escreval(x)
escreval("END")
fimalgoritmo
probes.candidateStderr: current.alg:6:7: E001: cannot assign real to inteiro
probes.comparison: Both reject assigning 4/2 to inteiro. VisuAlg prints the BEGIN marker before reporting REAL para INTEIRO at line 6; PortuGo emits E001 before execution and exits 0.

probes.source:
algoritmo "logical-evaluation"
var
n: inteiro
funcao right(): logico
inicio
n <- n + 1
retorne verdadeiro
fimfuncao
inicio
escreval("BEGIN:logical-evaluation")
n <- 0
se falso e right() entao
escreval("UNEXPECTED")
fimse
escreval("E=", n)
n <- 0
se verdadeiro ou right() entao
escreval("OU=", n)
fimse
escreval("END:logical-evaluation")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:logical-evaluation
E= 1
OU= 1
END:logical-evaluation

Fim da execução.
probes.comparison: Both right-hand calls execute: n is 1 after falso e right() and verdadeiro ou right(). Numeric spacing differs.

probes.source:
algoritmo "for-mutation"
var
i, n: inteiro
inicio
escreval("BEGIN:for-mutation")
n <- 0
para i de 1 ate 3 faca
n <- n + 1
i <- 100
fimpara
escreval("N=", n)
escreval("I=", i)
escreval("END:for-mutation")
fimalgoritmo
probes.referencePanelText:
Início da execução
BEGIN:for-mutation
N= 3
I= 3
END:for-mutation

Fim da execução.
probes.comparison: Both execute three loop bodies despite assigning i <- 100. After the loop VisuAlg prints i as 3 while PortuGo prints 100. VisuAlg memory grid still displays 100; the screenshot preserves that UI discrepancy.
